requests.title: ATM withdrawal debited but cash not dispensed
requests.description: Dear Sir, yesterday evening several customers at our Mirpur booth ATM reported that their accounts were debited for cash withdrawal but no notes came out. The switch log shows response ATM-91 for these. Three customers are already at the branch asking for refund. Please check why the debit is posted when the dispense fails.
requests.environment: Live, ATM switch production, booth ATM terminal at Mirpur branch
requests.steps_to_reproduce:
1. Customer inserts card and enters PIN
2. Selects BDT 10,000 withdrawal
3. Machine shows 'please wait' then 'transaction failed', card returned
requests.expected_result: No debit when cash is not dispensed, or automatic reversal
requests.actual_result: Account debited, no cash, no auto reversal in 24 hours
